title: Azoth Keycard
description: The file a user supplies to extend or override what this library ships: components, fluids, fittings, coefficients and declarative model definitions. Each section carries an `x-azoth-stage` of `runtime`, read when a calculation is called, or `compiled`, consumed by a generator.

schema_version.description: The keycard format's version. Version 2 added `components`, `coefficients` and `models`.

keyholder.description: Who is asserting the right to use these values. Optional, and nothing in azoth reads it: no result carries it and no check requires it.

name.description: The person or organisation holding the licence, as they want to be named.

licence.description: A fetchable reference to the licence itself, so a reviewer can see the terms a value was used under. Optional: a keycard carrying only public data has no licence to name.

fluids.description: Property tables, keyed by fluid name, overriding or extending `data/fluids/`.

components.description: A component databank, keyed by substance name and then by parameter name. A component is a *set* of named parameters rather than a fixed record, because different models need different ones. Supplying a name the shipped databank already has overrides it; a new one extends it. The parameter names and their canonical units are declared in `component.schema.json`.

kij.description: Binary interaction parameters, overriding or extending `data/components/kij.csv`. An array of rows rather than a map, because the key is a *pair*. These are the values a cubic's mixing rule reads.

temperature_k.description: The temperature the parameter was fitted at, where the source says. Optional: most published `kij` are treated as constants.

associations.description: Association parameters, keyed by substance name, overriding `data/components/components.csv`. A section of its own rather than a key under `components` because a card may state a scheme for a substance whose critical constants it does not touch, and because the scheme is a name from a closed vocabulary where every other component parameter is a number in a unit. The parameter names and their canonical units are declared in `association.schema.json`.

coefficients.description: The constants a calculation takes as arguments, keyed by calculation id and then by input name. These are a *default*: a caller who passes the argument explicitly wins and the keycard is not consulted. A value is a number, a vector or a matrix, matching how the spec declares that input - which is what lets a card supply a parameter no upstream table carries, such as a UNIQUAC interaction matrix.

value.description: The number, or the numbers when the input it supplies is declared as a vector or a matrix. `unit` applies to every entry alike - a matrix whose rows carried different units would be a table, not a coefficient.

unit.description: Required, and checked against the spec's declared unit for that input. A coefficient declared in the wrong unit is a factor with no symptom.

convention.description: Which convention the value is stated in, where the quantity is not a true ratio. `control_valve_cv`'s `Cv` is declared `dimensionless` because no vocabulary unit can express `gpm/sqrt(psi)`.

models.description: Declarative model definitions: named choices from closed vocabularies plus numeric parameters, with nothing to execute. Both implementations interpret the form independently and are cross-checked.

kind.description: The model family. A kind is admitted only when both implementations run it and a contract test holds the vocabulary to them together, so widening this enum happens alongside the implementation, never before it.

shape.description: The cubic shape, named as a pair rather than as loose numbers because it fixes the cubic's two constants (`e`, `f`). A shape is admitted only when both implementations run it and a contract test holds the vocabulary to them together.

alpha.description: The alpha function: `[1 + kappa(1 - sqrt(Tr))]**2` with `kappa = 0.37464 + 1.54226*omega - 0.26992*omega**2`. One member, for the same reason as `shape`.

mixing_rule.description: Van der Waals one-fluid mixing with binary interaction parameters, which is what `eos.vdw1f_mix_binary` implements. A keycard's `kij` rows are the parameters this rule reads.

components.description: Component names, resolved against this keycard's `components` section.

alpha_parameters.description: The extra parameters an alpha function needs. Present and empty for the one this build implements, which needs none.
